text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки takes first place in the Arima
Kinen,
and the stands ring with resonant
cheers and
applause!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's overcome with emotion but has
managed to
show her audience a
beautiful dream. She bows
respectfully
to them and promises that her
miracle
will go on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She has fulfilled her goal of becoming
the
greatest entertainer ever. She's
found real
confidence and the path she's
meant to take.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The curtains close on Фудзи Кисэки's show,
but the
end is merely another beginning.
The start of her
next show will come
sooner than we know...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
